'''Anjali Kunapaneni''' is an Indian-American voice actor for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Kunapaneni was born on December 13, 2000 in {{wp|Washington D.C.}}, USA.<ref>https://www.instagram.com/p/CTfUzDIsCMD/</ref> They became a voice actor as an adult. They joined  {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where they voiced [[Project Mew]] member [[Danika]]. They gained a more notable role in {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Roy]].

Kunapaneni is {{wp|Non-binary gender|non-binary}} and uses they/them pronouns.
